Service status and risks

Development stage. Institutional enrolment, token issuance, transfers and redemptions are unavailable through this site. An issuer, custodian, payout providers and eligible jurisdictions will be disclosed after verification and approval.

Holder and payment risks

A payment stablecoin is an issuer claim. It carries no bank-deposit insurance, credit-union share insurance or government guarantee. The holder relies on the issuer’s terms and capacity to redeem. A validated blockchain transfer and beneficiary access to fiat are separate events.

Any future service would require disclosed fees, redemption eligibility and timing, restrictions, a complaints route and procedures for failed payouts.

Site data

This informational site uses no enquiry form, analytics script or third-party font request. Hosting and network providers may process standard request information to serve and protect the site. External websites apply their own data policies.

Use of this site

The material describes a proposal and illustrative scenarios. The site creates no account, token allocation or redemption agreement.

Dollar.coop is a proposed initiative developed with FORUS.
